about.title: About Us
about.story: The story of the CPK platform is, above all, that of two technology enthusiasts, Melik Messaoudi and Edem Aifia. Noticing that communication between administration, parents, and students lacked a modern digital bridge, they decided to take matters into their own hands. Armed with their vision and lines of code, they built this space from scratch. Their goal? To prove that Tunisian youth can create professional, secure, tailor-made tools to modernize education.

privacy.title: Your data, privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains, simply, what information Collège Pilote du Kef collects through this platform, and why.
privacy.collected1: Identity: national ID (CIN), parent's first and last name, child's class.
privacy.collected2: Contact: phone number and email, used to log in and to notify you of a teacher absence.
privacy.collected3: Schooling: timetable, teacher absences, homework, and presence on community spaces.
privacy.collected4: SMS history (content and delivery status), for technical follow-up.
privacy.purpose: This data is used solely for the school's administrative and educational management (account validation, communication, timetable tracking). It is never sold or shared with third parties.
privacy.contact: Contact us at 99766801 or by email at contact@cpkef.tn.

onboardingTour.welcomeBody: Your account is ready! Let's take a quick tour of the features — it only takes a minute.
onboardingTour.dashboardBody: Find your children, teacher absences, and all your important info at a glance.
onboardingTour.timetableBody: Check the class timetable, updated automatically whenever a class is cancelled.
onboardingTour.homeworkBody: See homework to do, and test/exam dates, sorted by subject.
onboardingTour.feedBody: Follow school life: photos, reels, likes and comments, just like social media.
onboardingTour.ideasBody: Suggest an improvement and vote for your favorite ideas — the month's top idea gets featured on the Feed.
onboardingTour.notificationsBody: Turn on notifications so you never miss anything, even with the site closed.
onboardingTour.finishBody: Explore at your own pace — help is always available at the bottom of every page.
